subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: The merge lane remains the sole classifier of actual proposal risk and keeps its lane/risk-class output unchanged; impl-review remains the sole projector of that class to the `skip`, `standard`, or `deep` review band; planner-driven routing consumes the projected band only through FR-25, where `skip` denotes the lowest band and never authorizes zero model-backed review.
rationale: planned assurance may join actual proposal risk but must neither relocate either existing predicate nor erase the universal review floor
fit_criterion: merge-lane lane/risk-class fixtures and impl-review class-to-band fixtures remain byte-for-byte unchanged; the complete FR-25 join suite consumes every projected band and clamps `skip` to at least `standard×1`
